values.reopens: not announced; closed through the 2026/27 off-season
values.note: Campground and day-use area closed from noon Sept 25, 2026 for water-system and campground repairs, including off-season and winter camping in 2026/27.

status.source: https://apps.web.maine.gov/cgi-bin/online/doc/parksearch/details.pl?park_id=18 ('Mt. Blue State Park's Webb Beach Campground and day-use area will be closed for the season at noon on Friday September 25th. This closure includes off-season and winter camping during the 2026/27 season.'), read 2026-11-02

season.source: The false came from note prose. The agency's closure notice speaks of 'off-season and winter camping' at this campground, and the booking site gives only an online reservation season (5/18-9/13 in 2026), so neither page says it shuts for winter. Read 2026-11-02

values.note: Online reservation season 5/18-9/13 in 2026; first-come after that. Triangles on the park map are non-reservable sites. Also by phone: 800-332-1501 in Maine, 207-624-9950 from outside.

booking.source: https://cg-public-prod.web.maine.gov/public/new-step01 ('Online Reservation Season: 5/18/2026 - 9/13/2026'; 'Reserve up to 14 nights per reservation') + the park map legend ('Non-Reservable Campsite'), read 2026-11-02

hookups.source: https://cg-public-prod.web.maine.gov/cg/cgimages/mountblue.jpg (rev. 04/25/2025: shaded 'Campsite with electric & water hookup' at sites 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 13, 15), read 2026-11-02. Amperage not stated, so electric stays absent.

values.note: Length classes on the park map: S up to 20 ft (pop-up or tent), M 25, L 30, X 35, U over 35. Twelve sites have electric and water.

facilities.source: https://cg-public-prod.web.maine.gov/cg/cgimages/mountblue.jpg (legend and symbols: Showers, Drinking Water, Trailer Dumping Station) + https://apps.web.maine.gov/cgi-bin/online/doc/parksearch/details.pl?park_id=18 ('RV dumping station', 'Showers'), read 2026-11-02

note: Wooded campground on the Webb Beach side of Webb Lake near Weld (Mount Blue itself is ~8 km NE). Electric and water sites 1-15 sit together by the entrance; sites in the S class (up to 20 ft) won't fit a 23-ft rig. --Claude
summary: Marked temporarily closed: agency notice shut the campground from Sept 25, 2026 through the 2026/27 off-season for water-system repairs. Confirmed 136 sites, 12 water/electric sites named, length classes, 14-night limit; cleared year_round false resting on note prose. Not waterfront stands.
flags: CLOSURE: notice is dated '09/121/2026' as printed (sic). No reopening date; I wrote 'not announced'. Whether it opens for May 2027 isn't stated. The reservation site still lists the park with its 2026 season and no closure wording.

WATERFRONT not waterfront stands: the official map puts all loops well inland with a 'Trail to Beach' to Webb Lake; the agency says 'a short walk from a sandy beach'. Imagery shows unbroken canopy to the shore, ~250+ m from the nearest visible loop road. No site plotted on the lake.
HOOKUPS: exactly twelve per the official map: 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 13, 15 reservable and 7, 11 non-reservable. Amperage unstated anywhere I could read, so electric stays absent.
MAX LENGTH: class U is 'Greater than 35' camper', no upper figure, so I left max_rig_ft absent rather than write 35.
PHONE: stored (207) 585-2347 is 'Park season'; the agency gives (207) 585-2261 for fall, winter and spring. apply.py doesn't write phone.
UNREAD: www.maine.gov/dacf/parks pages answered 403 to plain UA, not retried, so the current fee table wasn't re-read; the stored $20/$30, $30/$40 fees (from 2026-10-12) stay as they were.

PIN fine: stored 44.68180,-70.44925 matches the coordinates printed on the map (44.681795, -70.449249) and the agency's entrance (44.681737, -70.449439); loops run west and south-west under canopy, can't plot a centroid.
